en: The postcard features a black-and-white photographic portrait of a decorated German military officer, identified by the uniform style, epaulets, and medals. The lower part of the front contains printed and handwritten German text, including 'DEUTSCHE HELDEN 3' (German Heroes 3) and a signature. The back of the postcard has segmented spaces for correspondence and the address, and text in German, with a museum stamp 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'.
